page.title: Import data
page.description: Import customers and season passes from a CSV file exported by another program: preview, validation report and all-or-nothing apply.

upload.title: New import
upload.description: Upload a CSV file (UTF-8 or Windows, separator ; or ,), at most 5 MB and 20,000 rows. The file does not touch your data until you confirm.

columns.customers: Recognised columns: cognome (last name, required), nome, email, telefono, lingua, note, etichette, consenso_marketing, data_consenso, versione_informativa. English names and those of the most common programs are accepted too.
columns.season_passes: The customer columns plus posto (required, the spot label), pacchetto, dal, al, fascia. Each row creates a season pass on the chosen season, priced from the price list.

upload.fileHint: Marketing consent is never assumed: without the column the preview setting applies.

review.title: File “{{file}}”
review.previewHint: Choose the options and press “Preview”: no data is changed.
review.applyDescription: {{create}} items will be created, {{update}} updated and {{skip}} skipped. All or nothing: at the first error nothing changes.
review.discardDescription: The uploaded file is deleted. No data was changed.

options.updateExistingHint: Off: existing customers stay as they are and the row is skipped.
options.createCustomersHint: Off: rows whose customer is not found are errors.
options.consentDefault: Marketing consent when the column is missing
options.consentDefaultHint: Turn it on only if the consent is documented in the previous program.

report.fixAndRetry: Fix the rows with errors in the file and upload it again: the import applies only without errors.

codes.spot_unavailable: Spot already taken in the period.

failed.title: Import refused
failed.description: No data was changed. Check the errors, fix the file or the options and preview again.
